extracted.intended_audience: researchers and authors considering submitting to the journal; people comparing journals' peer-review processes
extracted.subtask_description: A per-journal profile of metrics and user-contributed reviews describing the journal's peer-review process, handling times, acceptance/rejection statistics, and quality ratings to inform authors' submission decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: % accepted last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value shown as 'n/a' on this page when editor has not provided it. Used to indicate journal selectivity/acceptance rate from previous year.

rubrics_metrics.name: % immediately rejected last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as 'n/a' if not provided. Indicates desk-rejection rate (immediate rejections) for the prior year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Articles published last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number of published articles in the previous year; 'n/a' if editor did not provide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscripts received last year
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total submissions received in the prior year; shown as 'n/a' if not provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access status
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates whether the journal is open access or provides OA options; 'n/a' if not specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript handling fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Whether the journal charges a processing/handling fee; 'n/a' if not provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact factors (provided by editor)
rubrics_metrics.description: Two-year impact factor / Five-year impact factor
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editorially provided impact metrics; shown as 'n/a' here. Used as a bibliometric indicator of journal influence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aims and scope
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editor-provided description of the journal's focus; this page notes 'The editor has not yet provided this information.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration first review round
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric metric (here: '4.8 months') representing average time from submission to completion of the first review round.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tot. handling time acc. manuscripts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total handling time according to manuscript records (here: '4.8 months'), representing end-to-end handling for tracked manuscripts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision time immediate rejection
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time to desk-rejection (here: '1 days'). Useful to estimate speed of editorial triage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average number of review rounds
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Average count of review rounds manuscripts undergo (here: '1.0 rounds').

rubrics_metrics.name: Difficulty of reviewer comments
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A qualitative metric (here: 'n/a') intended to capture how demanding reviewers' feedback is perceived to be.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average number of review reports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typical number of individual referee reports per manuscript (here: '3.3 reports').

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of review reports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User-reported rating (here: '3.3 / 5.0') indicating perceived helpfulness/quality of reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall rating manuscript handling
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aggregate user rating of the journal's manuscript handling process (here: '2.7 / 5.0').

rubrics_metrics.name: Latest review outcome and summary
rubrics_metrics.description: Latest review — Outcome: Rejected (im.). 2.7 Good process 4 reviews
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows the most recent submitted review's outcome and short commentary summary; useful as anecdotal evidence of editorial decisions and process quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disciplines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields the journal covers (here: 'Social psychology'); helps authors determine topical fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related journals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List of journals considered related (here: 'European Review of Social Psychology; Journal of Family and Economic Issues; Parenting'), useful for alternative submission venues or benchmarking.
